# Key findings (auto-generated from the SQL results)

> Based on synthetic data. Re-run on real data before quoting any figure.

1. **Overall:** ₹436,161,366 sales, ₹66,369,053 profit (15.22% margin) across 6,000 orders and 769 customers.
2. **Growth:** latest month (2026-10) sales are +24.0% vs the same month last year.
3. **Regions:** South leads with 27.2% of sales; East has the lowest margin (14.5%).
4. **Loss-making sub-categories:** Tables, Binders, Machines; lowest margin is Tables (-13.3%).
5. **Discounts:** margin falls from 31.1% at 0% discount to -35.6% in the 31%+ band; margins turn negative from the 21-30% band.
6. **Concentration:** the top 20% of customers generate 66.5% of sales.
7. **Retention:** 88.7% of customers ordered more than once (avg 7.8 orders).
8. **Shipping:** Standard Class has the highest share of line items with more than 5 days between order and ship dates (54.6%). This is an order-to-ship measure, not confirmed delivery lateness.

## Recommendations (template - adapt to real data)
- Cap discounts on loss-making sub-categories or reprice them.
- Protect and reward the top-20% customer group; run win-back campaigns on 'At Risk' RFM segments (query 08).
- Investigate the lowest-margin region and the shipping mode with the longest order-to-ship time; the source data does not include a delivery timestamp.
